BiblicalUsage: Jashobeam is named once, in 2 Samuel 23:8. In 2 Samuel 23:8 we read, "These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jashobeam comes to us in a list, yet I hold that a list was God's way of keeping a family.
